segments.text: As the man tried to swing the speedboat round, the steering wheel came away in his hands.
segments.translation: 当那人试图转动快艇时，方向盘在他手中脱落了。

segments.text: He waved desperately to his companion, who had been water skiing for the last fifteen minutes.
segments.translation: 他拼命向他的同伴挥手，他的同伴在过去15分钟里一直在滑水。

segments.text: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown violently into the sea.
segments.translation: 两人还没来得及意识到发生了什么，就被猛烈地抛入大海。

segments.text: The speedboat had struck a buoy, but it continued to move very quickly across the water.
segments.translation: 快艇撞上了一个浮标，但它继续在水面上快速移动。

segments.text: Both men had just begun to swim towards the shore,
segments.translation: 两人刚开始向岸边游去，

segments.text: when they noticed with dismay that the speedboat was moving in a circle.
segments.translation: 这时他们惊愕地发现快艇正在绕圈行驶。

segments.text: It now came straight towards them at tremendous speed.
segments.translation: 它现在以惊人的速度直冲他们而来。

segments.text: In less than a minute, it roared past them only a few feet away.
segments.translation: 不到一分钟，它呼啸着从他们身边几英尺处驶过。

segments.text: After it had passed, they swam on as quickly as they could because they knew that the boat would soon return.
segments.translation: 快艇驶过后，他们尽可能快地继续游，因为他们知道快艇很快就会返回。

segments.text: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger when the boat again completed a circle.
segments.translation: 他们刚好来得及游出危险区，快艇又完成了一个圆圈。

segments.text: On this occasion, however, it had slowed down considerably.
segments.translation: 然而这次，它的速度明显慢了下来。

segments.text: The petrol had nearly all been used up.
Before long, the noise dropped completely and the boat began to drift gently across the water.
segments.translation: 不久，噪声完全消失了，快艇开始在水面上缓缓漂流。
